rounds.name: screening_lhs
rounds.generation_rule: seeded Latin hypercube, random.Random(20240611), stratified per dimension, snapped to step grid

rounds.name: local_refinement
rounds.generation_rule: coordinate finite-difference stepping around the current best point: for each dimension in plan order try -step then +step, clamp to bounds, drop already-evaluated points, take the first n_points survivors; if none survive, fall back to the nearest unvisited grid point (deterministic expanding-radius scan). next_batch.py instantiates this rule; the exact points are pinned in the decision log and are reproducible from the seed plus the results CSV.

rounds.name: confirmation_repeat
rounds.generation_rule: re-run the current best point >= 2 times (identical coordinates, distinct replicate ids) to estimate noise.

strategy_rationale: rule 4 fired: 6006 combinations exceed the budget (10). Budget split: screening 4 (40%), local refinement 4, confirmation repeats 2. 0 history points are recorded for context but do not consume the new budget.

global_stop_criteria.name: low_improvement
global_stop_criteria.definition: relative improvement of the best response between the last two completed search rounds < 2%; when it fires before the confirmation round, the repeats are skipped and reported as outstanding confirmation items

global_stop_criteria.name: boundary_constrained
global_stop_criteria.definition: the current best point lies within one step of the bounds in EVERY dimension

global_stop_criteria.name: all_candidates_duplicate
global_stop_criteria.definition: every generated candidate was already evaluated and no unvisited fallback grid point exists

replay_instructions: Re-run plan_search.py with the same --space/--budget/--history/--seed to reproduce this plan byte-for-byte. Re-run next_batch.py with this plan and the same results CSV to reproduce every emitted batch; search_log.py --verify re-checks the append-only decision log.
